newsitem.title: USA: Rexene sets date for special meeting.
newsitem.headline: Rexene sets date for special meeting.

text.p: Rexene Corp said Monday that it has set August 26, 1997 as the date for a special stockholders meeting to vote on the proposed merger of Rexene with a subsidiary of Huntsman Corp.
Rexene said that if stockholders approve, it expects the merger to be consummated on August 27, 1997.
The record date for stockholders eligible to vote on the proposed merger is July 25, 1997.

On June 9, 1997, Rexene and Huntsman signed a merger agreement which provides for all outstanding shares of Rexene common stock to be acquired by Huntsman in a merger transaction for $16 per share in cash.
